scope: Exact moving finite-volume number/energy reservoir exchange, implicit conditional electron-Maxwell cutoff law, and explicitly tagged native BED energy-coordinate bridge. No population evolution, deposition calculation or old source semantic replacement.

reuse.existing_law: moving_interface and bath_energy_rate already implemented; do not claim new continuum theorem or rerun old tests

units.energy: physical kinetic eV unless explicitly tagged
units.number: particle count per fixed physical volume
units.density_trace: count per fixed physical volume per eV
units.current: count per fixed physical volume per second
units.spatial_expansion_work: excluded from this local collision component; must have separate owner if activated

inputs: signed edge_fluxes F_i, length m+1, F_m=0
finite_volume_exchange.definition: F=j-w*N is increasing-energy current relative to moving cell edge; mesh velocity is already included exactly once
finite_volume_exchange.Phi: -F_0; positive is resolved to reservoir; negative is physical/reclassification backflow
finite_volume_exchange.source_terms: none in frozen API; birth packets remain separately owned count+physical energy sources
finite_volume_exchange.upper_boundary: only F_m=0 admitted; nonzero upper current must reject rather than disappear

electron_thermal_cutoff.closure: conditional pure-electron Maxwell caloric reservoir U=(3/2)*Nthermal*theta; this selected closure is not demonstrated by conservation
electron_thermal_cutoff.moment_dependency: DefaultL0 assumes supplied current moment independent of unknown theta_dot. A moving-grid moment must supply L; omission is not allowed merely because previous API had no argument.

affine_FV_source.frozen_state: all e,c,n,j and selected interface reconstruction traces fixed instantaneously
affine_FV_source.reconstruction_branch: If upwind trace depends on motion sign, freeze one branch, solve and require sign consistency; no global single-affine claim across switching branches.

electron_thermal_cutoff.guard: Ceff<=0 rejects selected closure branch; report C/Ceff conditioning factor for positive branch, no hidden regularization or tolerance
missing_actual_inputs: evolved/reconstructed interface density N(c) and derivative/current
calibrated Maxwell reduction and boundary/domain error

tag_native_bed_pair.true_kinetic_rule: E=xi-delta; velocity, pressure, stopping, cutoff and Maxwell law use true kinetic E
tag_native_bed_pair.charge_gauge: species energy'=species energy-delta*q; free electron q=-1, every ion receives -delta*q. Total shift=-delta*Qnet is constant for charge-conserving reactions.
tag_native_bed_pair.cutoff_covariance: c_tag=c+delta,h_tag=h+delta,e_tag_i=e_i+delta; I_h and Ceff invariant; resolved_Udot_tag=resolved_Udot-delta*Phi,reservoir_Udot_tag=reservoir_Udot+delta*Phi; physical reservoir energy recovered by subtracting delta*N.
tag_native_bed_pair.native_to_tagged_SDCS: k_tag(xi,omega)=k_native(xi-delta,omega-delta), Jacobian1; no differential kernel recomputation in this delta test
guards: reject missing/wrong input_kind, including legacy physical source semantics
tag_native_bed_pair.physical_reconciliation_claim: Exact tagged representation and all-charge energy ledger only; legacy primary atoms remain immutable physical-kinetic declaration. Adopting new physical spectrum/threshold/cross-section convention requires separate coherent source remap.

groups: moving3cell exact rational reference and count/energy cancellation
discriminating omitted mesh-work and omitted same-current energy terms
conditional thermal Schur rational reference and caloric identity
native BED tagged pair and recovered physical energies
charge-gauge total-energy invariant for one ionization event

roundoff.rationale: finite sums/products/division in tiny fixed O(1) rational fixtures; slack covers binary64 rounding only, not model error
